answer: New agents lock a refundable bond that vests only after two later settlement epochs, and only if five established peers whose sponsor clusters are disjoint from the applicant have attested a completed job. The intake contract walks each attester's controller graph, rejects any intersection, and slashes the bond if a later proof shows key reuse. Location grants no discount: an operator on the ridge at zenith, or beneath a willow, still cannot mint cheap clones, because each extra name must post a fresh bond and recruit a non-overlapping attester set that one controller cannot honestly supply.
